expectationBasis: After creation succeeds, the editor opens and shows only a blank worksheet named Sheet1, with Sheet1 active and A1 selected; refreshing or returning to the home page and reopening produces the same state.

Worksheet tabs on the same editor page use the ARIA tab role, with the active tab indicated by aria-selected="true"; the active worksheet grid uses the ARIA grid role, has the accessible name "Worksheet grid"
the current cell and every cell within the currently selected rectangular region expose aria-selected="true"
